name: Constellate Proteomics
team: Carlos de Lannoy (co-founder, CEO); Dennis de Beeld (co-founder, CBO); Arian Khoshchin (co-founder, head of marketing)
description: TU Delft biotechnology spin-out developing an instrument to check antibody quality during cell-line selection. A Dutch conference report named the team in November 2025. By September 2026 its accelerator reported two licensed university patents and pilots in China and Switzerland. Graduate Ventures announced a pre-seed investment the following month. This funded historical case shows what a scout could have seen before that announcement.

evidence.excerpt: The Dutch Life Sciences Conference named Constellate Proteomics and its three team members in the autumn Venture Challenge cohort.
The company dates its TU Delft spin-out launch to 15 February 2026 and describes its single-molecule antibody analysis technology.
Its accelerator reported that Constellate licensed two TU Delft patents and was testing customer antibodies in China and Switzerland. Converting pilots into paid projects was still a milestone.
Graduate Ventures announced a pre-seed investment in the Delft company alongside Tech Scout Venture Fund and imec.istart.
Dealroom News covered the pre-seed financing on 20 October 2026. The date of its first company database entry remains unknown.
